title: Layrs SCM V1 common scalar contracts
description: Single authority for content ObjectId and safe repository-relative path syntax.

ObjectId.description: BLAKE3 content id over the object's normative identity bytes.

RepoPath.description: Non-empty NFC-normalized repository-relative path using slash separators. Validators must reject non-NFC input; RFC 8785 does not normalize Unicode.

RepoPathComponent.description: One non-empty NFC-normalized repository path component. Validators must reject non-NFC input.
